description: Make printable flashcards to cut out: math facts over a number range with the answer on the back, or word cards from a list such as sight words or spelling words. Returns a PDF link.

cards.description: math: every fact for each pair of numbers in the range, answer on the back, up to 100 cards. words: one word per card, like sight words.

from.description: Smallest number in the facts. Defaults to 0.

layout.description: fold: fold each sheet so the answer is on the back. duplex: print two-sided. Defaults to fold.

op.description: add, subtract, multiply or divide. Defaults to add.

seed.description: Shuffle order, used only with shuffle. Leave out for a new order.

shuffle.description: Deal the cards in a random order. Defaults to in order.

to.description: Largest number in the facts. Defaults to 9.

words.description: Up to 60 words, each up to 20 letters. One word per card.

name: make_flashcards
title: Make flashcards
